full_cycle_replay.assistance: Manually selected observed/map-derived road waypoints with actual CDP mouse/touch input; ordinary keyboard fighting and a late dodge. Agent-led review, not unaided human enjoyment research.
observations: Rescue return used actual touch and did not restart cooled pursuit.
A timed dodge opened the shield at the gathering aid stage.
Held touch restored aid and both readers reached the assembly.
Courier copying survived one interrupting injury.
The charter took one warned ram hit, escaped and completed on a different western route.

changes: Closer on-foot view with wider driving retained

final_public_recheck.desktop: High graphics; actual keyboard movement, strikes and dodge; gameplay capture inspected.
final_public_recheck.phone_emulation: 390x844 and 844x390; simultaneous actual movement/aim touches produced three strikes and movement; no horizontal overflow. Normal-time exposure to attacks caused capture; landscape heading and both recovery actions fitted the viewport, result scroll reset to zero.
final_public_recheck.rules_since_full_cycle: Only versioned import changed in city-rules.js; later edits are presentation and camera changes.
final_public_recheck.hardware_scope: Cloud Chromium emulation, not physical phones or Safari.

limits: Physical iPhone/Android hardware and Safari unverified.
Independent first-time-player enjoyment and retention unverified.
A background-tab cloud FPS reading was invalid as a game-performance conclusion; active-tab checks observed about 60 FPS in several scenes, not a device guarantee.
Faces, authored combat animation, autonomous crowds, traffic and detailed landmark/frontage geometry remain below the finished-game quality target.
